## Security and Privacy

- [ ] No `.env` values, credentials, logs, database contents, or private exports are included.
- [ ] Route, rendering, or data-access changes were reviewed for auth, validation, and PII exposure.
- [ ] Public endpoint or authorization behavior changes are documented.
- [ ] Synthetic test data is used instead of private runtime data.

## Maintainer Workflow

- [ ] Relevant Codex/project workflow considered: import review, metadata cleanup, duplicate resolution, artwork audit, database health, security audit, tests, or release notes.
- [ ] OpenAPI/client drift checked when API schemas changed.
- [ ] Live-service verification noted when deployment behavior changed.
- [ ] Changes to workflows, dependencies, deployment scripts, generated clients, auth, or secret handling are explicitly called out.

## External Contributor Notes

- Fork-based pull requests are welcome.
- First-time contributors do not need collaborator access or issue assignment.
- Pull requests that include unrelated workflow, dependency, credential, database, or deployment changes may be closed without merge.
